records.name: Scientometrics
records.scope_notes: Quantitative research on the production, communication and use of scientific and technological information. Candidate work includes research indicators, citation and collaboration networks, research evaluation, and computational studies of scholarly communication using existing records. Reviews are invited; a generic descriptive bibliography should not be assumed sufficient.

route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown; verify submission, page/length and print-colour policies before recommending a zero-total-cost route.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific publishing policy explicitly states that no APC applies to its subscription route; OA has a separate APC.

records.name: Research Evaluation
records.scope_notes: Research evaluation theory and practice, including assessment of researchers, organizations, funding programmes, research outputs and policy interventions. Existing-data studies and evaluation methods fit when tied to an evaluation problem. The journal excludes purely descriptive bibliometrics or standalone indicator development without a broader evaluation contribution. Discussion papers may receive editorial rather than external peer review.

records.name: Science and Public Policy
records.scope_notes: Policy research concerning science, technology and innovation. Candidate OSRI work includes existing-data studies of research systems, funding, collaboration and research-policy effects. A policy contribution is required; a software tool or narrow replication report alone is not an assumed fit. Perspectives and some letters are editorially reviewed, unlike the journal's standard research articles.

records.name: Accountability in Research
records.scope_notes: Research integrity, accountability and research policy across disciplines. Empirical analyses of published records, conceptual assessment and critical analysis can fit; new clinical studies are not a prerequisite. Candidate topics include reporting practices, reproducibility governance, peer review and research misconduct. Detailed article-type and length rules remain to be checked in the blocked author instructions.

records.name: Social Studies of Science
records.scope_notes: Science and Technology Studies rather than a general methods journal. Social or institutional analyses of research practices, collaboration and knowledge production may fit when they make an STS contribution. Original research, discussion papers, short research notes and review essays are listed; existing literature or documents can support suitable studies. Research articles are normally limited to 12,000 words.

route.conditions: Standard subscription publication is free to submit and publish. Optional Sage Choice OA is paid unless separately covered by an eligible agreement. Online colour is free; specifically requested print-colour reproduction is a separate optional cost.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for standard publication; avoid optional print-colour and optional OA charges.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific instructions explicitly exclude submission and publication fees, distinguish optional OA, and make print colour chargeable only when requested.

records.name: Research Ethics
records.scope_notes: Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Theoretical original articles and critical reviews allow work based on existing evidence; new clinical studies are unnecessary. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles.

route.conditions: Current Community Open Access policy states that authors and readers pay no costs and accepted articles have no APC. records.name: Journal of Information Science
records.scope_notes: Information science and knowledge management offer a route for computational analyses of scholarly information, research-information organization, retrieval and communication when there is a clear information-science contribution. Methods and algorithms can accompany a research article; this is not a standalone software-deposit venue. Average article length is 5,000–7,500 words, with brief communications up to 1,500.

records.name: Research Synthesis Methods
records.publisher: Cambridge University Press & Assessment on behalf of the Society for Research Synthesis Methodology
records.scope_notes: Cross-disciplinary development and evaluation of evidence-synthesis methods: statistical methodology, simulations, search and extraction, bias assessment, qualitative synthesis, graphics and software. Existing-data, computational and methodological research fits without a new clinical study. A routine subject-matter systematic review is not an assumed fit; demonstrate the methodological contribution.

route.conditions: Currently wholly OA at Cambridge, not the former Wiley hybrid route. A research-article corresponding author without an agreement, equity support or other funding may request a discount or full APC waiver after editorial acceptance; Cambridge assesses the request. A discount alone does not make publication free. Agreement and country-based eligibility are alternatives, not universal entitlements. Explicit submission-fee and any extra-charge confirmation remain outstanding.
route.other_mandatory_costs: APC applies unless a full waiver or full funding route is confirmed; other mandatory-cost confirmation remains outstanding.

fee_evidence.note: Current journal fee page identifies wholly OA publication with an APC, and links to agreement, equity and waiver routes.

notes: Eight journal records cover scientometrics, research evaluation/policy, integrity, scholarly information, social research practices, and evidence-synthesis methodology. Scope notes describe candidate fits, not editorial approval or manuscript-specific matching.

All substantive fee statements come from official journal/publisher sources. Direct pages were inspected where available; Accountability in Research has weaker official search-index evidence plus HTTP 403 access limitations.

Three records are marked verified_free from journal-specific no-author-cost policies. Four subscription candidates and one conditional-waiver candidate retain needs_verification because submission or additional compulsory-cost evidence is incomplete. A no-APC statement alone is not promoted to zero total author cost.

Research Synthesis Methods is now Cambridge wholly OA; stale Wiley subscription and fee instructions remain indexed. The waiver route is explicitly conditional and publication_fee remains charged until a full waiver/funding route applies.

Research Evaluation has conflicting official guidance: current online-only instructions state no colour/page charges, whereas a separate Charges page still lists print-colour charges. This conflict is retained for independent fee review.

Excluded lead: Quantitative Science Studies, https://direct.mit.edu/qss/pages/submission-guidelines (HTTP 403). The accessible society notice, https://www.issi-society.org/blog/posts/2022/november/open-access-publishing-in-quantitative-science-studies-an-update/, is dated 2022 and says its subsidy ended after 2022. It cannot establish a currently unconditional free route or a current waiver guarantee.

Excluded leads pending accessible current official fee evidence: Journal of Informetrics, https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-informetrics/about/open-access-options and https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-informetrics/publish/guide-for-authors (HTTP 403); Journal of Clinical Epidemiology, https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-clinical-epidemiology/about/open-access-options and https://www.jclinepi.com/content/authorinfo (HTTP 403). Third-party no-publication-fee summaries were not accepted as current primary evidence.

Diamond expansion leads intentionally not duplicated here: Meta-Psychology, Journal of Librarianship and Scholarly Communication, Information Research, LIBER Quarterly, and Engaging Science, Technology, and Society. Their fees and current scope require the assigned expansion agent's own checks.

No metrics or difficulty rankings were added. External peer review applies to standard research article routes; editorially reviewed perspectives/letters/discussions are called out where current instructions distinguish them.
Independent agent discovery is neither human scientific review nor a venue endorsement; fees and policies need rechecking near submission.
